purpose: Negative control for the two-potential signature (note Sec. 4 taxonomy). Same 4-CX ansatz family, parameters chosen so the heralded block is NORMAL (normality residual ~1e-12): predicted single-potential class, D antisymmetric, D_ii = 0, despite deviations of the same scale as the CTC circuit (v-span 0.862). If device noise generically produced two-potential structure, it would appear here; its absence certifies that the CTC circuit's D_ii != 0 is physics, not artifact.
experiment: forgery_normal_4cx; 20k shots/input; all 8 circuits ONE job; ibm_marrakesh (same device as the CTC-circuit confirmation)

decision_criteria.control_confirmed: single-potential VE >= 0.90 AND max|D_ii| <= 0.30 AND antisymmetry ratio <= 0.30
decision_criteria.control_failed: any criterion missed - report as such; a failure would UNDERMINE the two-potential signature's hardware interpretation and must be reported prominently, not buried

no_post_hoc_changes: Any deviation from this plan is exploratory and must be labelled so.
